analysis: The PR's only change to docs/developer/test.md is a documentation edit at head lines 1049-1050 (base 1049): the release SDK qualification now names SDK 27.2 / Swift 6.4.2 (Xcode 27.2) and links the build.md release toolchain section. The supplied units (base lines 2303-3108) are unchanged surrounding text, covering cluster, prefix-cache and tenant-partition test descriptions. I examined them against the threat model, including T-041 (prefix-cache tenant scoping, SSD tier, TTL). The prefix tenant partition table (around base lines 2644-2665) and the SSD prefix record encoding checks (around base 2819-2868) describe tests only and make no claims that loosen cache scope, TTL, HMAC naming or crypto. The build-toolchain bump is documentation and does not alter runtime code, trust boundaries, attestation, key custody, or authorization. No code, configuration, or CI workflow change is visible in the supplied evidence, so I found no security regression. Remaining unverified items: the patch excerpt shows only the doc line edit. The actual CI toolchain pin and the build.md anchor `sdk-27-release-builds-and-caches` are outside the supplied evidence. If other files in the PR change the toolchain or workflows, they would need separate supply-chain review, including pinning of Xcode 27.2 and artifact signing and qualification identity (A-017, T-054). That is not a finding for this doc-only unit.
